name: BRAND TEXT
description: "At Olympic Hot Tub, we pride ourselves on the quality and reliability of the hot tubs we carry, and on the people who provide our unparalleled customer service. We’re the oldest hot tub company in the Northwest and credited by the Seattle Times with introducing hot tubs to the Puget Sound area.  We’ve been locally owned and operated since our founding in August 1977. The reason for our business longevity? We believe it’s our commitment to great service. After all, 45% of our new hot tub business is by referral from our existing customers.  PeaceOfMind-300x232Our Peace of Mind Guarantee gives the strongest consumer protection assurance in the hot tub industry.  After making wood hot tubs for our first five years in business, we’ve sold only one line of portable spas since 1982 – Hot Spring Spas. Our commitment to carrying only the best-made hot tubs and to providing superior customer service has earned us national recognition. Thanks to our loyal customers who have purchased 2,000 wood tubs and over 25,000 Hot Spring®, Limelight Hot Tubs®, Hot Spot® and Freeflow® Spas. We’ve sold more seats than Century Link Field holds for a Seahawks game. There are more than 95,000 seats in our hot tubs in the Puget Sound area ready for hot tubbing every night of the year."
